method.mechanism: Agent hypothesis. Let n be the number of valid, strictly preceding states and c their incumbent mean. For n>0, candidate uses a(n)=0.15+0.10(n-4)/(n+4) in (1-a(n))*x+a(n)*c. The control uses a_control(n)=0.15-0.10(n-4)/(n+4). Both retain the incumbent current-state fallback at n=0. The opposite rules have the same coefficient range, parameter count and crossover at n=4, testing the proposed direction of length dependence.
